([[managing director]]) | industry = [[Textile]] | products = | revenue = {{increase}} ₹ 5,000 million | net_income = | assets = | equity = | owner = | num_employees = | website = {{URL|http://www.shivatex.in}} | company_slogan = | founded = 1980 | hq_location = [[Coimbatore]], [[Tamil Nadu|TN]], [[India|IN]] }} '''Shiva Texyarn Limited''' ({{BSE|511108}}, {{NSE|SHIVATEX}}) (formerly known as Annamallai Finance Limited (AFL)) is an Indian textile manufacturing company based in [[Coimbatore]], [[Tamil Nadu]].{{cite news|title=Look at Shiva Texyarn: Prakash Diwan|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/look-at-shiva-texyarn-prakash-diwan-1300075.html|work=[[Moneycontrol.com]]|date=16 October 2015}} The company manufactures [[yarn]], [[fabrics]], [[garments]], dry sheets and home textiles in [[India]].{{cite news|title=Exhibition showcasing alternatives to plastic products held|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Coimbatore/exhibition-showcasing-alternatives-to-plastic-products-held/article25357111.ece|work=[[The Hindu]]|date=29 October 2018}}{{cite news|title=Focus on Indian Spinning Industry – Shiva Texyarn|url=http://www.indiantextilemagazine.in/corporate-news/focus-on-indian-spinning-industry-shiva-texyarn/|work=IndianTextileMagazine|date=17 May 2017}}{{cite news|title=Shiva Texyarn ltd. (SHIVATEX) - Company History|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/shiva-texyarn-1258/information/company-history|work=[[Business Standard]]}}{{cite news|title=Shiva Texyarn updates on scheme of arrangement (demerger)|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/shiva-texyarn-updates-on-scheme-of-arrangement-demerger-117112400146_1.html|work=[[Business Standard]]|date=24 November 2017}} ==History== Shiva Texyarn was incorporated in March 2002. S.K. Sundararaman is the [[managing director]] of the company.{{cite web|title=Shiva Texyarn Limited - The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/shiva-texyarn-ltd/infocompanymanagement/companyid-58.cms|work=[[The Economic Times]]}} Shiva Texyarn was originally known as Annamallai Finance (AFL) and became a public limited company in 1986. Annamalai Finance Private Limited was established on 28 May 1980, and later became a public company on 25 November 1985. The name of the company changed to Shiva Textyarn Limited from the previous name of Annamalai Finance Ltd in October 2002.{{cite news|title=Shiva Texyarn Limited - India Infoline|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/shiva-texyarn-ltd/summary/1258|work=[[India Infoline]]}} Shiva Texyarn is listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] ({{BSE|511108}}){{cite news|title=Shiva Texyarn Ltd. - NDTV|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/shiva-texyarn-ltd_shivtex/reports|work=[[NDTV]]}}{{cite web|title=Shiva Texyarn Limited - Bombay Stock Exchange|url=https://beta.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/shiva-texyarn-ltd/shivtex/511108/|work=[[Bombay Stock Exchange]]}} and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] ({{NSE|SHIVATEX}}).{{cite web|title=Shiva Texyarn Limited - National Stock Exchange|url=https://www.nseindia.com/live_market/dynaContent/live_watch/get_quote/GetQuote.jsp?symbol=SHIVATEX|work=[[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]]}} The company is an associate of Bannari Amman Group and Bannari Amman Spinning Mills which is one of the largest textile groups in India. The company is 75% owned by shareholders connected to the group so the publicly floated stock is small.{{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/look-at-shiva-texyarn-prakash-diwan-1300075.html|title=Look at Shiva Texyarn: Prakash Diwan|website=Moneycontrol|date=16 October 2015 |access-date=26 December 2018}} ==Recognition== * Quality Circle Forum of India JUSE 5S Certified{{cite news|title=QCFI JUSE 5S Certified List 2018|url=https://qcfi.in/qcfi-juse-5s-certified-list-2018/|work=Quality Circle Forum}} * OEKO Tex Standard Certification{{cite news|title=Shiva Texyarn charting out a distinct success story|url=http://www.indiantextilemagazine.in/corporate-news/shiva-texyarn-charting-out-a-distinct-success-story/|work=Textile Magazine|date=4 May 2015}} * WRAP Certification{{cite news|title=Maid in India|url=https://www.somo.nl/wp-content/uploads/2012/04/Maid-in-India.pdf|work=[[Centre for Research on Multinational Corporations]]}} * Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) Certificate{{cite news|title=Shiva Texyarn Ltd. 849525 - Global Organic Textile Standard|url=https://www.global-standard.org/public-database/search/database/search_result/19824.html|work=GOTS}} ==See also== * [[Textile industry in India]] * [[Ministry of Textiles]] * [[Alok Industries]] * [[Parvathy Mills Limited]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *{{Official website|http://www.shivatex.in}} {{Portal bar|Companies|India}} [[Category:Companies based in Coimbatore]] [[Category:Textile companies of India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1980]] [[Category:1980 establishments in Tamil Nadu]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{india-company-stub}}
extract: Shiva Texyarn Limited (BSE: 511108, NSE: SHIVATEX) (formerly known as Annamallai Finance Limited (AFL)) is an Indian textile manufacturing company based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The company manufactures yarn, fabrics, garments, dry sheets and home textiles in India.
